en.title: Services will be paused soon
description: Services are scheduled to be temporarily paused from May 9 to May 25 due to participation in a military exercise. At the moment, services are still active, but the pause period is approaching. Messages can still be sent, but responses will be provided after returning from the exercise.

et.title: Teenused peatatakse peagi
description: Teenused peatatakse ajutiselt vahemikus 9.–25. mai seoses osalemisega kaitseväe õppusel. Hetkel on teenused veel aktiivsed, kuid peatamise periood on lähenemas. Kirju saab endiselt saata, kuid neile vastatakse pärast õppuselt naasmist.

en.title: Services are paused
description: Services will be unavailable from May 9 to May 25 due to participation in a military exercise. You are still welcome to send messages, but responses will be provided after returning from the exercise.

et.title: Teenused on pausil
description: Vahemikus 9.–25. mai ei toimu teenuste pakkumist. Põhjuseks on osalemine kaitseväe õppusel. Kirju võib endiselt saata, kuid neile vastatakse pärast õppuselt naasmist.
